committees.name: Committee A - evidence and acceptance criteria
committees.decision_reason: OPS-FLOW-001 has 5/5 checked acceptance criteria and three verification evidence rows. The evidence documents substantively cover the research deliverable requirement.

committees.name: Committee B - policy, transition, and dependency
committees.decision_reason: The default policy maps high feasibility with verification evidence to stable, requires user approval, and the dry-run guard passed with no warnings.

committees.name: Committee C - final adversarial decision
committees.decision_reason: No counter-evidence was found. Dirty worktree state is an operational caution, not a blocker, because the intended MCP mutation is scoped to OPS-FLOW-001 and stale patch checks protect the write.
